goal: Infrastructure as code scan gate: misconfigured infrastructure blocked before it is applied.
use: Infrastructure as code scan gate: misconfigured infrastructure blocked before it is applied. Use when a change touches infrastructure code.

steps.note: Confirm the scan runs on each infrastructure change, before the plan is applied.
Set the rule. High misconfigurations block the apply.
Check exceptions. Each suppressed rule needs a reason and an owner.
Check drift. Flag resources changed outside the code.
Report. Each finding with its resource, severity and the exception status.
